terminalRunLocation.cancelled: fail-closed; no successful terminal Run required
terminalRunLocation.capability_unavailable: fail-closed; no successful terminal Run exists

completedVerification.source: AgentRuntime verificationRecord spread of executeWithRun identity, persisted by TaskStore.bindRunVerification

finalBinding.taskIdAuthority: Task.taskId plus run.finalEvidence.taskId; finalResult does not independently persist taskId
finalBinding.requiredComparison: finalResult.runId/taskRevision and run.finalEvidence.taskId/runId/taskRevision must match the terminal Run identity

authoritativeAcceptanceRevision.reason: TaskStore.startRun creates the Run and increments Task.taskRevision once. bindRunVerification preserves the same identity.taskRevision. finalizeRun requires the same active identity and persists it in run.finalEvidence without incrementing Task revision.
authoritativeAcceptanceRevision.notRequired: The pure derivation does not use latest Task.taskRevision as the authority; later unrelated Task persistence must not invalidate the original verifier acceptance revision.

capabilityUnavailableDifference.writeSide: Existing production path persists finalResult.verified=true; known deferred risk NON_TERMINAL_RUNTIME_VERIFIED_TRUE_WITHOUT_BOUND_VERIFIER.
capabilityUnavailableDifference.replaySide: terminalResult must ignore that untrusted write-side boolean and derive verified=false because terminalState is capability_unavailable.
